crossRefs.note: They hatch adders’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web. He who eats of their eggs dies; and that which is crushed breaks…
They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips.

translations.web: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.
translations.bsb: The infant will play by the cobra’s den, and the toddler will reach into the viper’s nest.
translations.kjv: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice' den.
translations.asv: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the adder's den.
